Refitting

Removing

- Fit a new cylinder head gasket on the cylinder block taking care to ensure that it is the same size as the one removed.

The cylinder head gasket is the ASTADUR type.

- On account of the special material from which these gaskets are made they undergo a polymerization process whilst the engine is working, becoming considerably harder during usage. In order to ensure that the polymerization process takes place, observe the precautions described below:

- Keep the gasket sealed in its nylon container and only take it out shortly before fitting.

- Do not lubricate the gasket or get oil or grease on it.

- Position the cylinder head on the cylinder block/crankcase.

- Release the supporting hooks and remove the mounting bracket.
